## O'Reilly Automotive, Inc.
- **December 31, 2012**: $103 (Source: [ORLY fiscal 2016 annual report (10-K), page 29](documents/report.md))
- **December 31, 2011**: $92 (Source: [ORLY fiscal 2016 annual report (10-K), page 29](documents/report.md))
- **December 31, 2016**: $320 (Source: [ORLY fiscal 2016 annual report (10-K), page 29](documents/report.md))

- **December 31, 2014**: $151 (Source: [ORLY fiscal 2016 annual report (10-K), page 29](documents/report.md))

## Return on O'Reilly Automotive, Inc. Stock in 2012

  - Initial value: $92
  - Final value: $103
  - Return: \\( \frac{103 - 92}{92} \times 100 = 12.0\% \\) (Source: [ORLY fiscal 2016 annual report (10-K), page 29](documents/report.md))
